items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: We played out the Suburban Garden. I was playing bass. Played out the Suburban Garden in 1928.

ctx.x: Who did Henry Sino play with, you said? Now you saw him with him. With Ridgely.
Ridgely's dance band. Who bowled bass in the old days? That's something I remember today.
